scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind moving and selecting icons.
Single click: selects an item. Double click: opens many files or apps.
Drag: holds the button while moving an item. Scroll wheel: moves through a page. Right click: opens a context menu in many systems.
With an adult supervising, practise single click and double click using a computer if one is available. Without a computer, draw the screen and explain each step to a partner.
